briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek R2 escalate frontier race with new reasoning benchmarks

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race intensifies as multiple labs release advanced reasoning models amid record quarterly funding. Geopolitical tensions rise with export controls tightening on advanced chips. Focus shifts to multi-agent security as deployments scale rapidly.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI releases o4 with ARC-AGI score of 92%. Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus and Google's Gemini 2.5 Ultra compete closely. Meta open-sources Llama 4 while xAI and DeepSeek push efficiency gains.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and BCI applications.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA ships Blackwell B200 at scale while TSMC ramps 2nm production. Microsoft and Google announce new 100k H100 clusters in Europe and Asia.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first ASI system emerge from a US lab or a multinational consortium by 2028?
